    r'permission:\s*(.*)',  # permission: something
    r'grant:\s*(.*)',  # grant: something
    r'audit:\s*(.*)',  # audit: something
    r'session:\s*(.*)',  # session: something
    r'access:\s*(.*)',  # access: something
    r'allow:\s*(.*)',  # allow: something

    r'override:\s*(.*)',  # override: something

]
